bullets.text: Windows 365 for Agents Unveiled - **Microsoft** expands Windows 365 to support autonomous AI agents, enhancing productivity and security.
Introducing Winapp CLI - **Microsoft** launches an open-source CLI to streamline Windows app development across various frameworks.
AI Transformation and Security - **Microsoft** highlights the importance of integrated security in AI-driven organizational transformations.
Windows 11 Insider Preview Update - New features and fixes are rolling out in the latest **Windows 11** Insider Preview build.
Phishing Campaign Targeting SharePoint - **Microsoft Defender** uncovers a complex phishing campaign exploiting SharePoint services.
Notepad and Paint Updates - **Microsoft** rolls out enhancements for Notepad and Paint apps to Windows Insiders.
Xbox App on Arm PCs - The **Xbox** app is now available on Arm-based **Windows 11** PCs, expanding gaming accessibility.
AI Agents Security Posture - **Microsoft** discusses the unique security challenges posed by the rise of AI agents.
Identity Security Priorities for 2026 - **Microsoft** outlines key strategies for enhancing identity and network access security.
